The day of the surgery twenty-eight years ago still remains vivid in Hodge-Williams' memory.
That morning, she was [41] into the surgical room on a surgical cart. She remembers being [42] by doctors, the noise of their metal surgical tools and the feeling of being [43].
"They were getting on with their jobs, not realizing I was really [44]," she said.
But that [45] when the anesthesiologist (麻醉师) arrived. Hodge-Williams recalled he had a kind [46] and a cap covered in sunflowers.
"Seeing my fear, he said to me, 'OK, why not think about something you like?' At first, I felt quite [47], 'How could he ask me this question when I was so fearful!'"
"In a kind of silly manner, I replied, 'Well, what do you like?' And very [48], he said, 'Singing.'"
So Hodge-Williams asked him to [49]. "Then he started singing 'The Phantom of the Opera,' which accompanied me to gradually [50]."
In the years since that day, Hodge-Williams has experienced multiple surgeries. But she still imagines that doctor [51].
"I can [52] him almost with me through every surgery: his calm and [53] voice, his gentle and relaxed smile... They meant much to me, not just the science of medicine, but also the [54] and care for me. Although I don't know his name, I will always be [55] to him." Hodge-Williams said.

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。空后提到“on a surgical cart”（在手术推车上），cart是有轮子的，因此使用wheel的动词形式，表示“用推车推”。
questions.supplement:
A(dragged)：语境句：The heavy box was dragged across the floor. 固定搭配：drag on, drag down
B(showed)：语境句：She showed me around the campus. 固定搭配：show off, show up
C(carried)：语境句：He carried the injured child to safety. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on
D(wheeled)：语境句：The patient was wheeled into the operating room. 固定搭配：wheel around, behind the wheel

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据常识和语境，在手术室里，病人躺在手术台上，医生们“围在”周围(surrounded)准备手术。Cared需加for，treated意为“治疗/对待”，不如surrounded具体贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(surrounded)：语境句：The house is surrounded by beautiful trees. 固定搭配：be surrounded by/with, surround sound
B(supported)：语境句：The roof is supported by wooden pillars. 固定搭配：support oneself, in support of
C(cared)：语境句：He deeply cared about his students' future. 固定搭配：care for, care about
D(treated)：语境句：The doctor treated her for a rare disease. 固定搭配：treat sb to sth, treat as

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。虽然周围有很多医生，但下文提到医生们各自忙碌“not realizing I was really terrified”，这让身处金属器械噪音中的作者感到孤立无援(alone)。
questions.supplement:
A(tired)：语境句：She was too tired to go out tonight. 固定搭配：be tired of, be tired out
B(alone)：语境句：She felt completely alone in the big city. 固定搭配：let alone, leave sb alone
C(eager)：语境句：He is eager to learn new skills. 固定搭配：be eager for, be eager to do
D(annoyed)：语境句：He was annoyed at her constant interruptions. 固定搭配：be annoyed with sb, be annoyed at/about sth

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。根据第五段第一句“Seeing my fear”和最后一句“when I was so fearful”可知，作者当时非常恐惧(terrified)。
questions.supplement:
A(excited)：语境句：The kids were excited about the upcoming trip. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
B(curious)：语境句：I was curious to know what they were discussing. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
C(terrified)：语境句：She was absolutely terrified of spiders. 固定搭配：be terrified of, be terrified to do
D(awkward)：语境句：There was an awkward silence in the room. 固定搭配：feel awkward, awkward situation

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文描述了冷冰冰且令人恐惧的手术室氛围，而“But”表示转折，说明麻醉师到来后，这种情况发生了“改变”(changed)。
questions.supplement:
A(worsened)：语境句：The weather worsened rapidly overnight. 固定搭配：worsen the situation, continually worsen
B(developed)：语境句：She developed a deep interest in art. 固定搭配：develop into, develop a habit
C(changed)：语境句：His attitude changed after hearing the truth. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
D(repeated)：语境句：He repeated his question because no one answered. 固定搭配：repeat oneself, repeat after me

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。空处与后文的“a cap covered in sunflowers”并列，是作者肉眼看到的麻醉师的外貌特征。结合后文提到的“gentle and relaxed smile”，可知他带着和善的“微笑”(smile)。
questions.supplement:
A(smile)：语境句：She greeted the guests with a warm smile. 固定搭配：smile at, all smiles
B(heart)：语境句：He has a kind heart and helps everyone. 固定搭配：by heart, lose heart
C(order)：语境句：The books are arranged in alphabetical order. 固定搭配：in order to, out of order
D(comment)：语境句：He made no comment on the recent event. 固定搭配：make a comment, no comment

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。作者当时非常害怕，而医生却问她“喜欢什么”，作者的第一反应是觉得这个问题很“奇怪/反常”(strange)。
questions.supplement:
A(desperate)：语境句：They made a desperate attempt to save the company. 固定搭配：be desperate for, in a desperate situation
B(strange)：语境句：It is strange that he hasn't arrived yet. 固定搭配：feel strange, look strange
C(ashamed)：语境句：He felt ashamed of his rude behavior. 固定搭配：be ashamed of, feel ashamed for
D(depressed)：语境句：She felt lonely and depressed after moving. 固定搭配：feel depressed, clinically depressed

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。医生为了安抚极度恐惧的作者，其态度必然是镇定的、平静的(calmly)。这与后文提到的“calm and comforting voice”相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(confidently)：语境句：She answered the interviewer's questions confidently. 固定搭配：speak confidently, act confidently
B(calmly)：语境句：He reacted calmly to the unexpected emergency. 固定搭配：deal with calmly, breathe calmly
C(politely)：语境句：The waiter smiled and politely took our order. 固定搭配：decline politely, listen politely
D(proudly)：语境句：He proudly displayed his gold medal to the crowd. 固定搭配：proudly present, announce proudly

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文医生说自己喜欢“Singing(唱歌)”，顺理成章地，作者就请求他“唱”(sing)一首。
questions.supplement:
A(leave)：语境句：It's time for us to leave the party. 固定搭配：leave for, leave alone
B(continue)：语境句：The rain will continue throughout the night. 固定搭配：continue to do, continue doing
C(listen)：语境句：You should listen carefully to the instructions. 固定搭配：listen to, listen in
D(sing)：语境句：She loves to sing in the shower. 固定搭配：sing a song, sing along

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。麻醉师的职责是进行麻醉，随着麻醉药效发挥，再加上舒缓的歌声，作者逐渐“入睡”(fall asleep)。
questions.supplement:
A(come to life)：语境句：The quiet town comes to life during the festival. 固定搭配：bring to life, come back to life
B(hold my breath)：语境句：I had to hold my breath underwater for a minute. 固定搭配：hold one's breath, catch one's breath
C(pay attention)：语境句：Please pay attention to the warning signs. 固定搭配：pay attention to, attract attention
D(fall asleep)：语境句：He was so exhausted that he fell asleep immediately. 固定搭配：fall asleep, fast asleep

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词短语辨析。多年后作者经历了多次手术，虽然那个医生不在现场，但她依然想象他就在“自己身边”(by her side)陪伴着她。下文“almost with me”是重要提示。
questions.supplement:
A(in the way)：语境句：I couldn't move because a chair was in the way. 固定搭配：in the way, stand in the way
B(out of sight)：语境句：The ship sailed until it was out of sight. 固定搭配：out of sight, out of mind
C(by her side)：语境句：Her loyal dog was always by her side. 固定搭配：by one's side, side by side
D(in a hurry)：语境句：He left the office in a hurry to catch the train. 固定搭配：in a hurry, hurry up

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。因为医生实际并不在场（上文用了imagines），所以作者是通过想象在脑海中“描绘/浮现”(picture)出他陪伴在旁的画面。
questions.supplement:
A(picture)：语境句：Try to picture yourself lying on a sunny beach. 固定搭配：picture sb doing sth, get the picture
B(notice)：语境句：Did you notice any changes in his behavior? 固定搭配：take notice of, notice sb doing
C(remember)：语境句：I can't remember where I left my keys. 固定搭配：remember to do, remember doing
D(hear)：语境句：I could hear the birds singing outside my window. 固定搭配：hear of, hear from

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。空处与calm并列，修饰voice，表示麻醉师的声音是平静且“令人安慰的/抚慰人心的”(comforting)。
questions.supplement:
A(unique)：语境句：Everyone's fingerprints are absolutely unique. 固定搭配：unique to, unique style
B(comforting)：语境句：A hot cup of tea is very comforting in winter. 固定搭配：comforting words, a comforting thought
C(loud)：语境句：The loud music kept the neighbors awake all night. 固定搭配：out loud, loud and clear
D(clear)：语境句：The instructions must be clear and easy to follow. 固定搭配：make it clear, clear up

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。空处与care(关爱)并列。不仅仅是医学技术，还有对病人的共情与“同情”(sympathy)。在医疗语境中，sympathy常指对病人痛苦的理解和同情心。
questions.supplement:
A(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a great inspiration for artists. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration
B(praise)：语境句：The firefighters received high praise for their bravery. 固定搭配：in praise of, win praise
C(sympathy)：语境句：We feel deep sympathy for the victims of the earthquake. 固定搭配：have sympathy for, out of sympathy
D(suggestion)：语境句：Can you offer any suggestions on how to improve this? 固定搭配：make a suggestion, open to suggestion

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。尽管不知道医生的名字，但正是他的善意帮作者度过了恐惧，所以作者会永远对他心存“感激”(grateful)。固定搭配 be grateful to sb。
questions.supplement:
A(loyal)：语境句：He has been a loyal supporter of the team for years. 固定搭配：be loyal to, loyal customer
B(helpful)：语境句：Thank you for your very helpful advice. 固定搭配：be helpful to, prove helpful
C(sensitive)：语境句：Skin is often highly sensitive to the sun. 固定搭配：be sensitive to, highly sensitive
D(grateful)：语境句：I am deeply grateful for your continuous support. 固定搭配：be grateful to sb for sth, forever grateful

section_2_word_form.passage:
"Roars the Yangtze River, sweeping everything eastward; the currents surge, in an unremitting way just like the emergence and disappearance of these shining [56] in history," chanted Ming Dynasty scholar Yang Shen in his poem, while [57] through Luzhou, Sichuan province, attracted by the river scene.
The river has nurtured (养育) and witnessed the progress of Chinese civilization [58] in return, artists over centuries have never stopped describing it [59] great respect.
Recent examples of these descriptions [60] at New Scenery of the Yangtze River on Sept 14, an exhibition in Wuhan. More than 100 paintings, watercolors, photos and mixed media works [61] at the exhibition presented varied [62] landscapes and dynamic cultures along the waterway.
At the exhibition, Quiet Nature, a group of drawings by ink artist Liu Wanming, shows the much-beloved giant panda not only to reflect its appeal but also to attempt to protect this species and its environment. Liu says [63] has been guiding his creation is an idea of Chinese philosophy — to pursue [64] in the treatment of details, while to present the extensiveness of the world. It is a wisdom that keeps reminding people to observe nature, to consider from the standpoints of other lives, and [65] to get along with the world.

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。figure在此意为“人物（尤指历史或著名人物）”。前有these修饰，故需用复数形式figures。
questions.supplement: 正确形(figures)：语境句：Many historical figures played important roles in this event. 固定搭配：historical figures, public figures。原词figure其它变形：figurative(adj.)比喻的, figure out(v. phrase)弄明白。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处为状语从句的省略（或分词作状语），主语Yang Shen与journey（旅行）之间是主动关系，且在进行中，故用现在分词journeying，即while (he was) journeying的省略。
questions.supplement: 正确形(journeying)：语境句：While journeying across the country, she kept a daily diary. 固定搭配：journey through, begin a journey (n.)。原词journey其它搭配：make a journey, a long journey。

questions.explanation: 考查连词。前后两部分“The river has nurtured...”与“in return, artists... have never stopped...”构成完整的并列句，表示“长江孕育了文明，作为回报（同时），艺术家们也不断描绘它”，填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He worked hard, and eventually achieved his goal. 固定搭配：and so on, both... and...。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。表示“带着极大的敬意”，固定搭配为 with great respect。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The students greeted their professor with great respect. 固定搭配：with respect, treat sb with respect。

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态和语态。主语是Recent examples，表示复数；时间状语是on Sept 14（过去的具体时间），故用一般过去时。examples与show是被动关系，故填were shown。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were shown)：语境句：The new products were shown at the international exhibition last week. 固定搭配：be shown to, show off。原词show其它变形：showing(n./v-ing), showy(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句子的谓语动词是presented，works与display之间是被动关系，用过去分词作后置定语，修饰works，意为“在展览上被展出的作品”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(displayed)：语境句：All the artifacts displayed in the museum are over a thousand years old. 固定搭配：be displayed on/at, proudly displayed。原词display其它变形：display(n.)展览。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。修饰名词landscapes（风景），需要用nature的形容词形式natural（自然的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(natural)：语境句：The country is famous for its stunning natural beauty. 固定搭配：natural resources, natural disaster。原词nature其它变形：naturally(adv.), naturalist(n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查主语从句。空处引导主语从句“___ has been guiding his creation”，且在从句中充当主语，表示“……的事物”，故填what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What surprised me most was his sudden decision to quit. 固定搭配：what to do, no matter what。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。pursue是及物动词，其后需要接名词作宾语，accurate（准确的）的名词形式是accuracy（准确性）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(accuracy)：语境句：The journalist always checks her facts to ensure accuracy. 固定搭配：with accuracy, high accuracy。原词accurate其它变形：accurately(adv.), inaccurate(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词并列。与前文的“to observe nature, to consider from the standpoints... ”构成不定式的并列结构，故填to learn（填learn也可接受，但补全to更符合严格的排比对称结构）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to learn)：语境句：It is never too late to learn a new language. 固定搭配：learn to do, learn from。原词learn其它变形：learned(adj.)博学的, learning(n.), learner(n.)。
